samples.question: Three colored carts begin in three docks arranged LEFT, MIDDLE, and RIGHT. Each beige parcel is identified by its pip count; the red outline marks the parcel to track. Read the seven cards from left to right. On an orange card, the two pictured colored carts exchange docks and carry their parcels with them. On a purple card, the two pip-coded docks exchange only the parcels currently there while their carts stay put: one pip means LEFT, two MIDDLE, and three RIGHT. Cart colors always name the carts themselves, wherever they currently are. Which dock contains the red-outlined parcel after all seven cards? Answer LEFT, MIDDLE, or RIGHT.
